about_the_game:
Ever-Shifting Economic Battleground
A dynamic market system reacts to natural disasters, seasonal cycles, and NPC production. Savvy merchants hoard surplus goods and sell at premium prices.

Living Social Ecosystem
Each NPC has a unique life path: reclusive farmers may hide genius, bankrupt merchants can rise as tycoons. Your actions reshape social networks.

Ultimate Power Game
Drive village development through council decisions on infrastructure and economic policies, balancing interests to control the community’s fate.

Limitless Life Simulation
Define your philosophy: futures market mogul by day, lakeside idler by night. Choose to passively observe village evolution.

Realistic Environmental Challenges
Adjust crop rotation by soil moisture levels, enhance skills to combat climate shifts, and cultivate premium crops as an agricultural innovator.

short_description: The Era of Pioneers is an open-world sandbox game combining deep strategic management and immersive life simulation. Shape your destiny by controlling dynamic economic systems, building social networks with autonomous NPCs, and crafting countryside living through seasonal cycles.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
